name: mode_cli
description: CLI interface for managing ClaudeClockwork execution modes (default, adaptive, claude-min)
author: ClaudeClockwork

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action: menu (interactive), list (show all modes), get (show current), set (change mode), info (detailed info)

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mode name for set action: default, adaptive, or claude-min

examples: /mode set default - Switch to Pure Ollama mode
/mode set adaptive - Switch to Adaptive mode
/mode set claude-min - Switch to Claude Minimal mode
